# Total Deposit

## Create Validation Set
```{r}
# Panel
total_deposit_panel_data = deposit_panel_data[, c(26, 8, 41:43, 10:12, 14, 19, 22, 3, 44:58)]
tdep_panel_cleaned = na.omit(total_deposit_panel_data)

# Create factors
tdep_panel_cleaned$newdate = as.factor(tdep_panel_cleaned$newdate)
tdep_panel_cleaned$year = as.factor(tdep_panel_cleaned$year)
tdep_panel_cleaned$Region = as.factor(tdep_panel_cleaned$Region)
tdep_panel_cleaned$bkclass = as.factor(tdep_panel_cleaned$bkclass)
tdep_panel_cleaned$specgrp = as.factor(tdep_panel_cleaned$specgrp)
tdep_panel_cleaned$mutual = as.factor(tdep_panel_cleaned$mutual)
tdep_panel_cleaned$regagnt = as.factor(tdep_panel_cleaned$regagnt)

# Set the random seed for reproducibility
set.seed(2)

# Split the data into training and testing sets
train_frac <- 0.5
tdep_panel_cleaned <- tdep_panel_cleaned %>%
  arrange(newdate, cert) %>% # Arrange the data by quarter (newdate) and Bank_ID
  group_by(newdate) %>% # Group the data by quarter (newdate)
  mutate(sample_id = row_number(),
         total_rows = n()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(train_test = ifelse(sample_id <= total_rows * train_frac, "train", "test")) %>%
  select(-sample_id, -total_rows)

# Create training and testing datasets
tdep_panel_train <- tdep_panel_cleaned %>% filter(train_test == "train")
tdep_panel_test <- tdep_panel_cleaned %>% filter(train_test == "test")

# Drop the last column (the indicator of train vs test)
tdep_panel_train = tdep_panel_train[, -ncol(tdep_panel_train)] 
tdep_panel_test = tdep_panel_test[, -ncol(tdep_panel_test)] 

cor(tdep_panel_train[, 12:17])

# Dataframe for regression
tdep_panel_train_reg = tdep_panel_train[, -c(2, 4, 6, 13:16, 18:22)] # drop cert and newdate and various short-term interest rates
tdep_panel_test_reg = tdep_panel_test[, -c(2, 4, 6, 13:16, 18:22)] # drop cert and newdate and various short-term interest rates
tdep_panel_test_reg = tdep_panel_test_reg[tdep_panel_test_reg$Region != "Other", ]
```

### Natural Splines

```{r}
# Prepare the data
data <- tdep_panel_train_reg
data$log_Total_Deposits <- log(data$Total_Deposits)

# Create a function to calculate cross-validated MSE for a given degree of freedom
cv_mse_ns <- function(data, dof, k) {
  fit <- glm(log_Total_Deposits ~ ns(ffr_0, df = dof) + ns(`10y nom`, df = dof) + Region + year + offdom + 
                 offfor + specgrp + mutual + regagnt + `Umich consumer sent.x` + 
                 `Real disposable income.x` + Population.x + `total bank equity capital.x` + NASDAQ.x, 
               data = data)
  
  # Perform k-fold cross-validation
  cv_results <- cv.glm(data, fit, K = k)
  
  # Return the cross-validated MSE
  return(cv_results$delta[1])
}

# Set the random seed for reproducibility
set.seed(1)

# Define the number of cross-validation folds
k <- 5

# Calculate cross-validated MSE for each degree of freedom
max_df <- 10
mse_values <- sapply(1:max_df, function(dof_constant) cv_mse_ns(data, dof_constant, k))

# Store the results in a data frame
results_df <- data.frame(Degree_of_Freedom = 1:max_df, MSE = mse_values)

# Standard deviation of MSE
std_mse <- sd(results_df$MSE)

# Find the df with the lowest MSE
min_mse_df <- results_df[which.min(results_df$MSE), "Degree_of_Freedom"]

# Calculate the one standard deviation rule thresholds
upper_threshold <- results_df$MSE[min_mse_df] + std_mse
lower_threshold <- results_df$MSE[min_mse_df] - std_mse

# Create the plot
ggplot(results_df, aes(x = Degree_of_Freedom, y = MSE)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line() +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = MSE - std_mse, ymax = MSE + std_mse), width = 0.2, color = "red") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = lower_threshold, linetype = "dashed", color = "blue") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = upper_threshold, linetype = "dashed", color = "blue") +
  labs(title = "Cross-validated MSE vs Degree of Freedom",
       x = "Degree of Freedom",
       y = "MSE") +
  theme_minimal()
```

Final Model for the natural spline:

```{r}
spline.tdep.p = glm(log(Total_Deposits) ~ ns(ffr_0, df = 4) + ns(`10y nom`, df = 4) + Region + year + offdom + offfor + specgrp + mutual + regagnt + `Umich consumer sent.x` + `Real disposable income.x` + Population.x + `total bank equity capital.x` + NASDAQ.x, data = tdep_panel_train_reg)
```

### GAMS

```{r}
data <- tdep_panel_train_reg %>% 
  rename(Umich_consumer_sent = `Umich consumer sent.x`, 
         Real_disposable_income = `Real disposable income.x`,
         Population = Population.x,

         ten_year_nom = `10y nom`)

data$log_Total_Deposits <- log(data$Total_Deposits)

formula = log(Total_Deposits) ~ s(ffr_0) + s(ten_year_nom) + Region + year + offdom + offfor + specgrp + mutual + regagnt + Umich_consumer_sent + Real_disposable_income + Population + total_bank_equity_capital + NASDAQ
```

### Ridge Regression
 
```{r, warning=FALSE}
grid <- 10^seq(10, -2, length = 100)

x <- model.matrix(log(Total_Deposits) ~ ., tdep_panel_train_reg)[, -1]
y <- log(tdep_panel_train_reg$Total_Deposits)

x_test <- model.matrix(log(Total_Deposits) ~ ., tdep_panel_test_reg)[, -1]

set.seed(1)
cv.out.ridge <- cv.glmnet(x, y, alpha = 0, nfolds = 10)
plot(cv.out.ridge)

# Lambda value with the minimum mean cross-validated error
bestlam_min_ridge <- cv.out.ridge$lambda.min
cat("Best lambda (min MSE):", bestlam_min_ridge, "\n")

# Lambda value within one standard error of the minimum
bestlam_1se_ridge <- cv.out.ridge$lambda.1se
cat("Best lambda (1-SE rule):", bestlam_1se_ridge, "\n")

out.ridge <- glmnet(x, y, alpha = 0)
ridgecoef = predict(out.ridge, type = "coefficients", s = bestlam_1se_ridge)[1:57, ]

ridge.mod = glmnet(x, y, lambda = grid, alpha = 0)

ridge_lm_compare = abs(ridgecoef) < abs(summary(full.lm.p)$coef[, 1])

ridge_lm_compare
ridgecoef
```

Testing Data Prediction

```{r}
tdep_ridge_pred = predict(out.ridge, s = bestlam_1se_ridge, newx = x_test)
tdep_ridge_tmse = mean((log(tdep_panel_test_reg$Total_Deposits)-tdep_ridge_pred)^2)
```

### Principal Component Regression

```{r}
# Rename columns
tdep_panel_train_reg3 <- tdep_panel_train_reg %>% 
  rename(Umich_consumer_sent = `Umich consumer sent.x`, 
         Real_disposable_income = `Real disposable income.x`,
         Population = Population.x,
         total_bank_equity_capital = `total bank equity capital.x`,
         NASDAQ = NASDAQ.x,
         ten_year_nom = `10y nom`)

# Set the random seed for reproducibility
set.seed(1)

# Define the number of cross-validation folds
k <- 5

# Fit PCA regression model
pca_tdep_fit <- pcr(log(Total_Deposits) ~ ffr_0 + as.numeric(year) + 
                      ten_year_nom + offdom + 
                 offfor + Umich_consumer_sent + 
                 Real_disposable_income + Population + 
                 total_bank_equity_capital + NASDAQ,
               data = tdep_panel_train_reg3, 
               scale = TRUE, validation = "CV", segments = k)

# Calculate MSEP for each number of components
mse_tdep_pca <- MSEP(pca_tdep_fit)

# Convert MSEP values to a data frame
mse_tdep_pca_df <- data.frame(MSE = unlist(mse_tdep_pca["val"])[seq(1, 21, 2)], Number_of_Components = 0:10)

plot(mse_tdep_pca_df$Number_of_Components, mse_tdep_pca_df$MSE, type = "b", main = "Cross-Validated MSE v.s. Number of Principal Components", ylab = "CV MSE", xlab = "Number of Principal Components", col = "red")

# Optimal Number of Components
m_tdep_pca = mse_tdep_pca_df$Number_of_Components[which.min(mse_tdep_pca_df$MSE)]

# Get the coefficients for the optimal number of components
coef(pca_tdep_fit, m_tdep_pca)

pca_tdep_fit$coefficients

# Get the loading matrix for the PCA model
loading_matrix <- loadings(pca_tdep_fit)

loadings(pca_tdep_fit)[, 1:m_tdep_pca]
```

Testing Data Prediction

```{r}
# Create a new data frame with only the predictors from the testing data set
tdep_panel_test_reg2 = tdep_panel_test_reg %>% 
  rename(Umich_consumer_sent = `Umich consumer sent.x`, 
         Real_disposable_income = `Real disposable income.x`,
         Population = Population.x,
         total_bank_equity_capital = `total bank equity capital.x`,
         NASDAQ = NASDAQ.x,
         ten_year_nom = `10y nom`)

pca_tdep_test_predictors <- tdep_panel_test_reg2[, c("ffr_0", "year", "ten_year_nom", "offdom", "offfor", "Umich_consumer_sent", "Real_disposable_income", "Population", "total_bank_equity_capital", "NASDAQ")]

pca_tdep_test_predictors$year <- as.numeric(pca_tdep_test_predictors$year)

# Predict the final model with M components using the predict() function and the testing data
tdep_pca_pred <- predict(pca_tdep_fit, ncomp = m_tdep_pca, newdata = pca_tdep_test_predictors)
tdep_pca_tmse = mean((log(tdep_panel_test_reg2$Total_Deposits)-tdep_pca_pred)^2)
```
